```lean
intro x y
cases' le_total x y with hxy hyx
· exact h₂ _ _ hxy
· have h : y ≤ 0 := by
    rw [le_iff_neg_le]
    exact neg_le_neg hyx
  have h' : -y ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
    rw [Set.Ici, mem_set_Ici]
    exact le_reflect (le_refl 0) h
  have h'' : -x ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
    rw [Set.Ici, mem_set_Ici]
    exact le_reflect (le_refl 0) (le_trans (le_neg_self y) h)
  have hf : f (-y) ≤ f (-x) :=
    h₂ _ _ (le_trans (le_neg_self y) h)
  rw [h₁ y, h₁ x, hf]
  exact le_antisymm (le_trans (le_neg_self y) h) (le_trans (le_neg_self x) h')
```
